facts.statement: The type species of the genus is Perijasaurus lapaz.
facts.quote: The type species is Perijasaurus lapaz.

facts.statement: Perijasaurus lived around 175 million years ago during the Toarcian-Aalenian boundary of the early to middle Jurassic.
facts.quote: It lived during the Toarcian-Aalenian boundary around 175 million years ago (early to middle Jurassic period).

facts.statement: The holotype specimen, UCMP 37689, is a broken dorsal vertebra approximately 55 cm tall and 45 cm long.
facts.quote: The holotype, UCMP 37689, is a broken dorsal vertebra, around 55 cm tall and 45 cm centimeters long.

facts.statement: The fossil was discovered on March 27, 1943, at the western flank of the Serranía del Perijá mountain range by the Tropical Oil Company.
facts.quote: It was discovered on 27 March 1943 at the western flank of the Serranía del Perijá mountain range by the Tropical Oil Company

facts.statement: Rincón et al. (2022) classified Perijasaurus as a basal eusauropod.
facts.quote: Rincón et al. (2022) found Perijasaurus to be a basal eusauropod.

facts.statement: Perijasaurus fossils come from the La Quinta Formation in what is now northern Colombia and Venezuela.
facts.quote: Perijasaurus hails from the La Quinta Formation of northern South America, in what is now Colombia and Venezuela

facts.statement: The environment where Perijasaurus lived is interpreted as a tropical lowland forest.
facts.quote: The La Quinta environment is interpreted as a tropical lowland forest.

facts.statement: Perijasaurus belongs to the unranked family Eusauropoda.
Rincón et al. (2022) determined that Perijasaurus is a basal eusauropod closely related to Cetiosaurus, Patagosaurus, Bagualia, Nebulasaurus, and Spinophorosaurus.
facts.quote: Rincón et al. (2022) determinaron que Perijasaurus es un eusaurópodo basal cercanamente relacionado con Cetiosaurus, Patagosaurus, Bagualia, Nebulasaurus y Spinophorosaurus.

facts.statement: The environment of the La Quinta Formation is interpreted as having been a tropical lowland forest.
facts.quote: Se interpreta que el ambiente de esa formación corresponde a lo que fue un bosque tropical de tierras bajas.

facts.statement: Its location and time suggest that the first eusauropods achieved a broad distribution before the breakup of Pangaea and the Toarcian faunal turnover.
facts.quote: Su ubicación y temporalidad sugieren que los primeros eusaurópodos alcanzaron una amplia distribución antes del rompimiento de Pangea y el cambio faunístico de la época del Toarciano.

facts.statement: The time range for Perijasaurus is the Toarcian to Aalenian, from 180.4 to 170.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Toarcian to Aalenian (180.4 to 170.9 million years ago)
